
<p># Registration-form-for-chess<br />
A Flask web application that lets users register for a tournament. Admin
page with functions that can export all users signed up, drop the
database and compare users that have signed up online and have
registered on the page.</p>
<p>**TO RUN THE PROGRAM**<br />
&lt;br&gt;<br />
1: Download the repo &lt;br&gt;<br />
2: install requierments with &lt;br&gt;<br />
```bash<br />
pip install -r requirements.txt<br />
```<br />
&lt;br&gt;<br />
3: Run Index.py</p>
<p>```bash<br />
python Index.py<br />
```<br />
&lt;br&gt;<br />
4: localhost have opend on port 5000 where u can accsess the
page.&lt;br&gt;</p>
<p>You whould need to put it behind a proxy or in some way not run it
localy to use it in a real world senario.<br />
To allow users to scan the QR code that takes them to the
registration.</p>
<p>### QR code that binds to host ip and redirect to /Registration</p>
<p>### Login page for the admin page. (ONLY allows one Admin
account)</p>
<p>### Admin page where you can go back to the QR page, export everyone
that signed up to CSV, look at the entries, and drop everyone that have
signed up</p>
<p>### The Show entry page where you can see and compare signed up and
signed up in person at the event.</p>
